name: Jones

alpha.desc: The alpha view shows the front of the property from a distance across an arid, sparsely vegetated terrain with scattered juniper and pine trees throughout the approach|The residence is partially visible near the center of the view, set back significantly from the street with a curved driveway providing access through the natural landscape|A rectangular pool structure is visible to the upper left of the residence|Dense tree coverage along the front approach limits direct sightlines to the structure from the street.

bravo.desc: The bravo view shows the property from the right side, revealing the residence situated within a cleared landscape area surrounded by scattered conifers|The curved driveway loop is visible wrapping around the right side of the structure, and a landscaped green area is present immediately adjacent to the building|The terrain surrounding the property is open desert scrub with moderate tree density, providing reasonable vehicle movement around the right perimeter|No fencing or gates are visible restricting access on this side.

charlie.desc: The charlie view shows the rear of the property, which is dominated by open arid terrain with scattered juniper trees and no visible rear access road or path|The rear of the residence is not clearly visible due to tree coverage and the angle of the view|The rear approach is undeveloped natural terrain with no paved surface or defined access route visible|Responders approaching from the rear would encounter open desert scrub with scattered vegetation.

delta.desc: The delta view shows the left side of the property with the pool structure clearly visible in the upper portion of the frame adjacent to the residence|The curved driveway is visible along the left side, and the residence sits within a maintained landscape area|Scattered conifers are present throughout the left perimeter, and the terrain slopes gently across the property|No fencing, gates, or other access restrictions are visible on the left side.

considerations: The residence sits on a large parcel accessed by a single curved driveway connecting to Macalpine Loop, with the long approach and curved alignment requiring careful navigation for larger emergency vehicles. The property is set back substantially from the street, and dense scattered juniper and pine trees throughout the parcel limit sightlines from the road and between the structure and the perimeter. A large pool is located adjacent to and north of the residence and represents an open water feature. The rear and side perimeters have no paved access and consist of open desert scrub terrain that may be passable for off-road vehicles but not standard apparatus.
clarifications: Is the driveway entrance from Macalpine Loop gated or controlled, and if so, what is the access code or key box location? What is the surface composition of the driveway and can it support the weight of a ladder truck or heavy apparatus? Is there a secondary or emergency access point to the property other than the primary driveway? Does the pool have a surrounding fence or barrier not visible from above? Are there any propane or fuel storage tanks on the property not visible in the imagery?
